messages:
Ava (PM): Heads-up: three enterprise asks landed — strict EU residency, APAC latency SLAs, and a smooth migration path for current tenants. Need to prioritize for next two quarters.
Priya (Arch): I'd like to push a policy-compiler + placement estimator first. If we can predict capacity/cost for a template, sales and legal can decide acceptable guarantees.
Marcos (Sales): Customers want a clear product name they can sign for. Suggest we offer: Green (global-economy), Blue (latency-first APAC), Red (residency-first EU). Sales can pilot Blue/Red.
Rafi (Eng): Engineering view: two implementation lanes: soft-affinity (weighting + preferred nodes) and hard-isolation (reserved tranches). Soft-affinity is fast; hard-isolation needs admission controller + quota accounting.
Liam (SRE): Ops concerns: hard-isolation increases blast radius for hardware failures. Need evacuation playbook, automated fallback sequence, and an alarm that triggers cross-tenant shedding when reservation pressure > 80%.
Zoe (Legal): We can't promise "no-egress" unless we certify control plane + KMS residency + auditability. For pilots, include explicit fallback clauses and an opt-in attestation step.
Ava (PM): Proposed roadmap: Q1: policy-compiler, template catalog, placement estimator prototype. Q2: soft-affinity GA + telemetry + pilot signups. Q3: admission controller + reservation tranche pilot + contract appendix.
Priya (Arch): Launch gates for soft-affinity: accuracy of estimator within 15%, per-tenant percent-served-in-preferred-region metric, and <10% cost uplift baseline. For reservation pilot: automated dry-run admission and rollback hooks.
Rafi (Eng): API sketch for policy: ```route_template { name: "residency-red" goals: ["residency","availability"] reservation_mode: "soft|hard" }``` Dry-run should return placement delta and flagged tenants.
Marcos (Sales): I'll avoid selling hard-isolation until Zoe signs off on contract language and pricing. I'll recruit two pilot customers in EU/APAC for Q2 soft-affinity.
Liam (SRE): Ops acceptance: 48h canary ramp, chaos blackout to validate fallback, and runbook drill. If any P0 during canary, block GA.
Zoe (Legal): For the pilot contract, include: explicit fallback ordering, SLO deltas for fallback, and customer acknowledgment of possible degradation during migration.
Ava (PM): Action items: Priya 1 policy-compiler PR + template examples (10 days). Rafi 1 dry-run API spike (2 sprints). Liam 1 ops runbook + chaos plan (2 weeks). Marcos 1 pilot commitments + pricing sketch (1 week). Zoe 1 review pilot T&C (3 days). ops-bot: Reminder: add roadmap PR to #release-war-room by EOD Fri.
Marcos (Sales): ack. Will upload pricing options: instance premium, monthly tranche fee, and per-request uplift.
Rafi (Eng): I'll post the spike doc today with simulator assumptions.
Priya (Arch): I'll include model-variant parity checks in the compiler so routing prefers compatible artifacts.
Ava (PM): Thanks team. We'll reconvene after spikes to lock dates and customer commitments.
